resources.string: Copies only the selected skin, motion style, automatic AMP on unmetered networks and own preload policy. These settings apply across accounts on this device. Applying a skin also applies its bubble radius. No full Telegram backup: accounts, chats, saved articles, themes, proxies, DNS servers, credentials and access permissions are excluded. If no skin was explicitly selected, the copy leaves the destination skin unchanged. Review before applying. A cloud file provider may upload the file you choose to save.
